exposure.needed: whether operators run `flux push artifact --provider azure` from Azure DevOps runners (CLI usage in CI pipelines, not cluster configuration)

original.statement: In Flux 2.7.0, `flux push artifact --provider azure` is allowed to call the Azure CLI when it runs on Azure DevOps runners.

decision.reason: [ev-b4b297bb4480] limits the fix to `flux push artifact --provider azure` running on Azure DevOps runners. That is a CLI call in a CI pipeline, and no Helm values, manifests or cluster setting record it. An undecidable exposure with environment-visibility-gap, asking exactly whether operators run that command on DevOps runners, covers the same scope as the evidence and is neither broader nor narrower.
